file.content:
@echo off
setlocal EnableDelayedExpansion

echo ========================================================================
echo   NVIDIA CUTLASS 3.x Installer for RTX 4090
echo ========================================================================
echo.
echo   Press any key to begin...
pause >nul

cd /d "%~dp0"
title NVIDIA CUTLASS 3.x Installer

REM ========================================================================
REM Configuration
REM ========================================================================
set "CUDA_PATH=C:\Program Files\NVIDIA GPU Computing Toolkit\CUDA\v13.0"
set "VS_PATH=C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community"
set "CUTLASS_INSTALL_DIR=%~dp0CUTLASS"
set "TARGET_ARCH=89"
set "BUILD_TYPE=Release"
set "PARALLEL_JOBS=24"

echo.
echo [CONFIG]
echo   CUDA:      %CUDA_PATH%
echo   VS2022:    %VS_PATH%
echo   Install:   %CUTLASS_INSTALL_DIR%
echo   Target:    SM%TARGET_ARCH%
echo   Threads:   %PARALLEL_JOBS%
echo.

REM ========================================================================
REM Step 1: Verify Prerequisites
REM ========================================================================
echo [1/7] Verifying Prerequisites...

if not exist "%CUDA_PATH%\bin\nvcc.exe" (
    echo   [ERROR] CUDA 13.0 not found at %CUDA_PATH%
    goto :error
)
echo   [OK] CUDA 13.0

if not exist "%VS_PATH%\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" (
    echo   [ERROR] VS2022 Community not found
    goto :error
)
echo   [OK] VS2022 Community

where git >nul 2>&1
if %errorLevel% neq 0 (
    echo   [ERROR] Git not found
    goto :error
)
echo   [OK] Git
echo.

REM ========================================================================
REM Step 2: Install CMake
REM ========================================================================
echo [2/7] Checking CMake...

where cmake >nul 2>&1
if %errorLevel% neq 0 (
    echo   [INFO] Installing CMake via winget...
    winget install Kitware.CMake --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements

    REM Add CMake to PATH for this session
    set "PATH=%PATH%;C:\Program Files\CMake\bin"

    REM Verify cmake is now available
    where cmake >nul 2>&1
    if %errorLevel% neq 0 (
        REM Try alternate path
        if exist "C:\Program Files\CMake\bin\cmake.exe" (
            echo   [OK] CMake installed at C:\Program Files\CMake\bin
        ) else (
            echo   [ERROR] CMake not found after install. Try running again or install manually.
            goto :error
        )
    ) else (
        echo   [OK] CMake installed
    )
) else (
    echo   [OK] CMake found
)
echo.

REM ========================================================================
REM Step 3: Clone CUTLASS
REM ========================================================================
echo [3/7] Cloning CUTLASS 3.5.1...
echo   NOTE: CUTLASS 4.x is broken on Windows - using 3.5.1
echo.

if exist "%CUTLASS_INSTALL_DIR%" (
    echo   [INFO] Directory exists, updating...
    cd /d "%CUTLASS_INSTALL_DIR%"
    git fetch origin 2>nul
    git checkout v3.5.1 2>nul
    cd /d "%~dp0"
) else (
    git clone --depth 1 --branch v3.5.1 https://github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass.git "%CUTLASS_INSTALL_DIR%"
    if %errorLevel% neq 0 (
        echo   [ERROR] Git clone failed
        goto :error
    )
)
echo   [OK] CUTLASS ready
echo.

REM ========================================================================
REM Step 4: Setup Build Environment
REM ========================================================================
echo [4/7] Setting up build environment...

set "CUDACXX=%CUDA_PATH%\bin\nvcc.exe"
set "CUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR=%CUDA_PATH%"
set "PATH=%CUDA_PATH%\bin;%PATH%"

call "%VS_PATH%\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" amd64 >nul 2>&1
if %errorLevel% neq 0 (
    echo   [ERROR] VS environment setup failed
    goto :error
)
echo   [OK] Build environment ready
echo.

REM ========================================================================
REM Step 5: Configure CMake
REM ========================================================================
echo [5/7] Configuring CMake...

cd /d "%CUTLASS_INSTALL_DIR%"

if exist "build" rmdir /s /q build
mkdir build
cd build

REM Find cmake executable
set "CMAKE_EXE=cmake"
where cmake >nul 2>&1
if %errorLevel% neq 0 (
    if exist "C:\Program Files\CMake\bin\cmake.exe" (
        set "CMAKE_EXE=C:\Program Files\CMake\bin\cmake.exe"
    )
)

echo   Using: %CMAKE_EXE%
"%CMAKE_EXE%" .. -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64 -DCUTLASS_NVCC_ARCHS=%TARGET_ARCH% -DCUTLASS_ENABLE_EXAMPLES=ON -DCUTLASS_ENABLE_TESTS=OFF -DCUTLASS_ENABLE_PROFILER=ON -DCUTLASS_LIBRARY_KERNELS=gemm -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=%BUILD_TYPE% -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=%TARGET_ARCH%

if %errorLevel% neq 0 (
    echo   [ERROR] CMake configuration failed
    echo.
    echo   Make sure VS2022 has "Desktop development with C++" installed
    goto :error
)
echo   [OK] CMake configured
echo.

REM ========================================================================
REM Step 6: Build CUTLASS
REM ========================================================================
echo [6/7] Building CUTLASS...
echo   This takes 10-30 minutes. Using %PARALLEL_JOBS% parallel jobs.
echo.

"%CMAKE_EXE%" --build . --config %BUILD_TYPE% --parallel %PARALLEL_JOBS%

if %errorLevel% neq 0 (
    echo   [WARNING] Full build had errors, trying minimal build...
    "%CMAKE_EXE%" --build . --config %BUILD_TYPE% --target cutlass_library --parallel %PARALLEL_JOBS%
)
echo   [OK] Build complete
echo.

REM ========================================================================
REM Step 7: Set Environment Variables
REM ========================================================================
echo [7/7] Setting environment variables...

cd /d "%~dp0"

setx CUTLASS_PATH "%CUTLASS_INSTALL_DIR%" /M 2>nul
if %errorLevel% neq 0 setx CUTLASS_PATH "%CUTLASS_INSTALL_DIR%"

setx CUTLASS_INCLUDE_DIR "%CUTLASS_INSTALL_DIR%\include" /M 2>nul
if %errorLevel% neq 0 setx CUTLASS_INCLUDE_DIR "%CUTLASS_INSTALL_DIR%\include"

set "CUTLASS_PATH=%CUTLASS_INSTALL_DIR%"
set "CUTLASS_INCLUDE_DIR=%CUTLASS_INSTALL_DIR%\include"

echo   [OK] Environment variables set
echo.

REM ========================================================================
REM Complete
REM ========================================================================
echo ========================================================================
echo   INSTALLATION COMPLETE
echo ========================================================================
echo.
echo   CUTLASS Version:  3.5.1
echo   Install Path:     %CUTLASS_INSTALL_DIR%
echo   Include Path:     %CUTLASS_INSTALL_DIR%\include
echo   Target Arch:      SM89 - RTX 4090 Ada Lovelace
echo.
echo   Environment Variables Set:
echo     CUTLASS_PATH
echo     CUTLASS_INCLUDE_DIR
echo.
echo   Integration file already created at:
echo     Optimizer_V7_G3\acceleration\cutlass_integration.py
echo.
echo   RESTART YOUR TERMINAL to load new environment variables.
echo.
echo ========================================================================
goto :done

:error
echo.
echo ========================================================================
echo   INSTALLATION FAILED - See error above
echo ========================================================================
echo.

:done
pause

Here's what this script does:

## Summary

It's a **7-step automated installer for NVIDIA CUTLASS 3.5.1** targeting your RTX 4090 (SM89 / Ada Lovelace). It builds CUTLASS from source and wires it into your **Optimizer V8** project (`Optimizer_V7_G3\acceleration\cutlass_integration.py`).

### The 7 steps:
1. **Verify prerequisites** — Checks for CUDA 13.0, VS2022 Community, and Git
2. **Install CMake** — Uses `winget` if CMake isn't found
3. **Clone CUTLASS v3.5.1** — Shallow clone from GitHub (notes that "CUTLASS 4.x is broken on Windows")
4. **Setup build env** — Sets `CUDACXX`, activates VS2022 `vcvarsall.bat amd64`
5. **Configure CMake** — VS2022 generator, GEMM kernels only, profiler ON, tests OFF, Release mode
6. **Build** — Parallel build with 24 jobs (your Threadripper), with fallback to minimal `cutlass_library` target
7. **Set env vars** — Persists `CUTLASS_PATH` and `CUTLASS_INCLUDE_DIR` system-wide via `setx`

## What needs updating for Feb 2026

Several things are likely stale:

| Item | Current | Likely Update |
|------|---------|---------------|
| **CUTLASS version** | 3.5.1 | 4.x may now work on Windows — worth checking the [CUTLASS releases](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass) |
| **CUDA version** | 13.0 | Verify this is still your installed CUDA toolkit version |
| **"4.x broken on Windows" note** | Written months ago | CUTLASS 4.x has had several releases since — Windows support may be fixed |

Want me to check what the latest CUTLASS release is and whether 4.x Windows support has landed? I can also look at what's in `Optimizer_V7_G3\acceleration\cutlass_integration.py` to see the Python side of the integration.

Here's the honest answer: **it doesn't do anything right now.**

The `acceleration/` directory is a shell — the `__init__.py` references two files that were supposed to be carried over from V7:

- `cutlass_integration.py` — **doesn't exist**
- `high_impact_optimizer.py` — **doesn't exist**

The batch installer builds CUTLASS and sets environment variables, but the Python integration code that would actually *use* it was never written (or got lost between V7 and V8).

### What it *would* do if wired up

CUTLASS is a library for custom **GEMM (matrix multiply) kernels** on NVIDIA GPUs. The installer builds only `gemm` kernels for SM89. In the context of your optimizer, the intended use would likely be:

- **Benchmarking** — run CUTLASS GEMM profiler to measure real GPU throughput vs theoretical peak, giving you ground-truth numbers for optimization decisions
- **Accelerating AI workloads** — custom GEMM kernels for ComfyUI/PyTorch inference that bypass cuBLAS overhead

But since the integration code doesn't exist, the installer just builds CUTLASS and leaves it sitting in a folder. Your optimizer's actual GPU optimizations (TF32 override, NanoVDB CUDA, env vars) don't depend on CUTLASS at all — they work through environment variables and registry tweaks.

### Bottom line

The batch file works fine as a CUTLASS builder, but it's disconnected from your optimizer. Would you like me to look into whether it's worth wiring up, or is this something you'd rather leave parked?

    36→    """Expert identifiers for the MoE routing."""
    37→    GPU_SPECIALIST = "gpu_specialist"
    38→    HOUDINI_ENGINEER = "houdini_engineer"
    39→    UE5_ENGINEER = "ue5_engineer"
    40→    SYSTEM_INTEGRATOR = "system_integrator"
    41→
    42→
    43→@dataclass
    44→class AppProfile:
    45→    """Application detection and resource profile."""
    46→    name: str
    47→    process_names: list[str]
    48→    cmdline_pattern: re.Pattern | None
    49→    vram_budget_gb: float
    50→
    51→    @classmethod
    52→    def from_config(cls, name: str, cfg: dict) -> AppProfile:
    53→        pattern = cfg.get("cmdline_pattern")
    54→        return cls(
    55→            name=name,
    56→            process_names=cfg.get("process_names", []),
    57→            cmdline_pattern=re.compile(pattern) if pattern else None,
    58→            vram_budget_gb=cfg.get("vram_budget_gb", 0),
    59→        )
    60→
    61→
    62→@dataclass
    63→class ProcessInfo:
    64→    """Detected running process with resource usage."""
    65→    pid: int
    66→    name: str
    67→    app: str  # matched app name or "unknown"
    68→    vram_mb: float = 0.0
    69→    cpu_percent: float = 0.0
    70→
    71→
    72→@dataclass
    73→class SystemContext:
    74→    """Snapshot of the current system state for expert analysis."""
    75→    gpu_name: str = ""
    76→    driver_version: str = ""
    77→    gpu_temp_c: float = 0.0
    78→    gpu_util_pct: float = 0.0
    79→    vram_used_mb: float = 0.0
    80→    vram_total_mb: float = 0.0
    81→    power_draw_w: float = 0.0
    82→    pcie_gen: int = 0
    83→    pcie_width: int = 0
    84→    active_apps: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    85→    processes: list[ProcessInfo] = field(default_factory=list)
    86→    workflow_mode: WorkflowMode = WorkflowMode.IDLE
    87→    env_vars: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    88→
    89→
    90→@dataclass
    91→class Recommendation:
    92→    """A single optimization recommendation from an expert."""
    93→    expert: ExpertType
    94→    action: OptimizationAction
    95→    description: str
    96→    impact: float  # 0.0 - 1.0
    97→    confidence: float  # 0.0 - 1.0
    98→    parameters: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    99→
   100→    @property
   101→    def score(self) -> float:
   102→        return self.impact * self.confidence
   103→
   104→
   105→@dataclass
   106→class OptimizationResult:
   107→    """Result of applying a single optimization."""
   108→    recommendation: Recommendation
   109→    success: bool
   110→    message: str = ""
   111→    rollback_info: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
   112→
   113→
   114→@dataclass
   115→class CycleReport:
   116→    """Summary of one optimization cycle."""
   117→    context: SystemContext
   118→    recommendations: list[Recommendation]
   119→    applied: list[OptimizationResult]
   120→    skipped: list[Recommendation]
   121→    errors: list[str]

1→"""Config loader with hardware drift validation.
     2→
     3→Loads config.yaml, returns typed config, warns on drift from known truth.
     4→"""
     5→
     6→from __future__ import annotations
     7→
     8→import logging
     9→from pathlib import Path
    10→from typing import Any
    11→
    12→import yaml
    13→
    14→from .models import AppProfile
    15→
    16→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    17→
    18→# Ground truth from NVIDIA report 2026-02-07
    19→_KNOWN_TRUTH = {
    20→    "driver_version": "591.74",
    21→    "driver_type": "Studio Driver",
    22→    "gpu_model": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090",
    23→    "pcie_gen": 3,
    24→}
    25→
    26→
    27→def load_config(path: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    28→    """Load and validate config.yaml."""
    29→    if path is None:
    30→        path = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "config.yaml"
    31→    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    32→        cfg = yaml.safe_load(f)
    33→    _validate(cfg)
    34→    return cfg
    35→
    36→
    37→def _validate(cfg: dict) -> None:
    38→    """Emit warnings for any config drift from known hardware truth."""
    39→    gpu = cfg.get("system", {}).get("gpu", {})
    40→
    41→    driver = gpu.get("driver_version", "")
    42→    if driver != _KNOWN_TRUTH["driver_version"]:
    43→        logger.warning(
    44→            "Config driver %s != known truth %s",
    45→            driver, _KNOWN_TRUTH["driver_version"],
    46→        )
    47→
    48→    pcie = gpu.get("pcie", {}).get("gen", 0)
    49→    if pcie != _KNOWN_TRUTH["pcie_gen"]:
    50→        logger.warning(
    51→            "Config PCIe gen %s != known truth %s",
    52→            pcie, _KNOWN_TRUTH["pcie_gen"],
    53→        )
    54→
    55→    model = gpu.get("model", "")
    56→    if model != _KNOWN_TRUTH["gpu_model"]:
    57→        logger.warning(
    58→            "Config GPU model %s != known truth %s",
    59→            model, _KNOWN_TRUTH["gpu_model"],
    60→        )
    61→
    62→
    63→def get_app_profiles(cfg: dict) -> dict[str, AppProfile]:
    64→    """Build AppProfile objects from config."""
    65→    apps = cfg.get("apps", {})
    66→    return {name: AppProfile.from_config(name, data) for name, data in apps.items()}
    67→
    68→
    69→def get_optimization_settings(cfg: dict) -> dict[str, Any]:
    70→    """Return optimization section with defaults."""
    71→    defaults = {
    72→        "max_recommendations_per_cycle": 10,
    73→        "min_confidence": 0.6,
    74→        "dry_run_default": False,
    75→        "monitor_interval_sec": 60,
    76→    }
    77→    defaults.update(cfg.get("optimization", {}))
    78→    return defaults
    79→

1→# GPU Optimizer V8
     2→
     3→Personal workstation optimizer for RTX 4090 + Threadripper PRO 7965WX.
     4→Optimizes Houdini 21, UE 5.7, ComfyUI, and Claude Code.
     5→
     6→## Architecture
     7→
     8→```
     9→optimizer/
    10→  models.py          - All shared types (single source)
    11→  config.py          - YAML config loader + drift validation
    12→  telemetry.py       - Single NVML lifecycle + process detection
    13→  orchestrator.py    - Lightweight MoE coordinator
    14→  cli.py             - CLI entry point
    15→  experts/           - 4 expert analyzers (GPU, Houdini, UE5, System)
    16→  actions/           - 4 action handlers (env_var, registry, process, ini_file)
    17→acceleration/        - CUTLASS + high-impact optimizer (kept from V7)
    18→benchmarks/          - PyTorch GPU benchmark
    19→tests/               - pytest suite
    20→```
    21→
    22→## Commands
    23→
    24→```
    25→python run.py                    # Single optimization cycle
    26→python run.py --detect           # Show current system state
    27→python run.py --dry-run          # Preview changes
    28→python run.py --monitor 60       # Continuous monitoring
    29→python run.py --benchmark        # PyTorch GPU benchmark
    30→python -m pytest tests/ -v       # Run tests
    31→```
    32→
    33→## Hardware Truth (2026-02-07)
    34→
    35→- GPU: RTX 4090, Driver 591.74 Studio
    36→- PCIe: Gen3 x16 (should be Gen4 — BIOS issue)
    37→- CPU: Threadripper PRO 7965WX (24C/48T)
    38→- RAM: 128GB DDR5
    39→- Display: Apple Pro Display XDR 6016x3384
    40→
    41→## Key Design Decisions
    42→
    43→- Single NVML lifecycle (TelemetryProvider) — no double-init
    44→- ComfyUI detection via cmdline regex, not process name
    45→- Registry handler uses key_path/value_name/value_data (not setting/value)
    46→- Info-only recommendations logged but not dispatched to handlers
    47→- Experts only produce recs for their active workflow mode
    48→

1→"""Single NVML lifecycle + process detection.
     2→
     3→Fixes from V7:
     4→- Single nvmlInit()/nvmlShutdown() pair (no double-init bug)
     5→- Real per-process VRAM via nvmlDeviceGetComputeRunningProcesses()
     6→- ComfyUI detection via cmdline pattern (not all python.exe)
     7→- Claude Code detection
     8→"""
     9→
    10→from __future__ import annotations
    11→
    12→import atexit
    13→import logging
    14→import os
    15→import platform
    16→import re
    17→from typing import Any
    18→
    19→import psutil
    20→
    21→from .models import AppProfile, ProcessInfo, SystemContext, WorkflowMode
    22→
    23→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    24→
    25→# Try to import pynvml; gracefully degrade if unavailable
    26→try:
    27→    import pynvml
    28→    _HAS_NVML = True
    29→except ImportError:
    30→    _HAS_NVML = False
    31→    logger.warning("pynvml not installed — GPU telemetry will be unavailable")
    32→
    33→
    34→_UNSET = object()
    35→
    36→
    37→def _read_persisted_user_env() -> dict[str, str]:
    38→    """Read user environment variables from the Windows registry.
    39→
    40→    setx writes to HKCU\\Environment, but the current process only inherits
    41→    env vars from its parent shell. This reads the registry directly so
    42→    experts see vars persisted by previous optimizer runs.
    43→    """
    44→    if platform.system() != "Windows":
    45→        return {}
    46→    try:
    47→        import winreg
    48→        env: dict[str, str] = {}
    49→        with winreg.OpenKey(winreg.HKEY_CURRENT_USER, "Environment") as key:
    50→            i = 0
    51→            while True:
    52→                try:
    53→                    name, value, _ = winreg.EnumValue(key, i)
    54→                    env[name] = value
    55→                    i += 1
    56→                except OSError:
    57→                    break
    58→        return env
    59→    except Exception:
    60→        return {}
    61→
    62→
    63→class TelemetryProvider:
    64→    """Single NVML lifecycle manager + system snapshot."""
    65→
    66→    def __init__(
    67→        self,
    68→        app_profiles: dict[str, AppProfile] | None = None,
    69→        nvml_module: Any = _UNSET,
    70→    ):
    71→        self._handle = None
    72→        self._nvml_initialized = False
    73→        self._app_profiles = app_profiles or {}
    74→        # Allow injection for testing; None = explicitly disabled, _UNSET = auto-detect
    75→        if nvml_module is _UNSET:
    76→            self._nvml = pynvml if _HAS_NVML else None
    77→        else:
    78→            self._nvml = nvml_module
    79→
    80→        if self._nvml is not None:
    81→            try:
    82→                self._nvml.nvmlInit()
    83→                self._nvml_initialized = True
    84→                self._handle = self._nvml.nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex(0)
    85→                atexit.register(self._shutdown)
    86→                logger.info("NVML initialized (single lifecycle)")
    87→            except Exception as e:
    88→                logger.error("NVML init failed: %s", e)
    89→
    90→    def _shutdown(self) -> None:
    91→        if self._nvml_initialized:
    92→            try:
    93→                self._nvml.nvmlShutdown()
    94→                self._nvml_initialized = False
    95→                logger.info("NVML shutdown")
    96→            except Exception:
    97→                pass
    98→
    99→    @property
   100→    def available(self) -> bool:
   101→        return self._nvml_initialized and self._handle is not None
   102→
   103→    def snapshot(self) -> SystemContext:
   104→        """Gather full system context snapshot."""
   105→        ctx = SystemContext()
   106→        ctx.env_vars = dict(os.environ)
   107→        # Merge persisted user env vars (set by setx) that this process may not have inherited
   108→        ctx.env_vars.update(_read_persisted_user_env())
   109→
   110→        if self.available:
   111→            self._fill_gpu_info(ctx)
   112→            self._fill_gpu_metrics(ctx)
   113→
   114→        self._fill_processes(ctx)
   115→        ctx.workflow_mode = self._detect_workflow(ctx.active_apps)
   116→        return ctx
   117→
   118→    def _fill_gpu_info(self, ctx: SystemContext) -> None:
   119→        nvml = self._nvml
   120→        try:
   121→            ctx.gpu_name = nvml.nvmlDeviceGetName(self._handle)
   122→            if isinstance(ctx.gpu_name, bytes):
   123→                ctx.gpu_name = ctx.gpu_name.decode("utf-8")
   124→        except Exception:
   125→            pass
   126→
   127→        try:
   128→            ctx.driver_version = nvml.nvmlSystemGetDriverVersion()
   129→            if isinstance(ctx.driver_version, bytes):
   130→                ctx.driver_version = ctx.driver_version.decode("utf-8")
   131→        except Exception:
   132→            pass
   133→
   134→        try:
   135→            ctx.pcie_gen = nvml.nvmlDeviceGetCurrPcieLinkGeneration(self._handle)
   136→            ctx.pcie_width = nvml.nvmlDeviceGetCurrPcieLinkWidth(self._handle)
   137→        except Exception:
   138→            pass
   139→
   140→    def _fill_gpu_metrics(self, ctx: SystemContext) -> None:
   141→        nvml = self._nvml
   142→        try:
   143→            mem = nvml.nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo(self._handle)
   144→            ctx.vram_total_mb = mem.total / (1024 * 1024)
   145→            ctx.vram_used_mb = mem.used / (1024 * 1024)
   146→        except Exception:
   147→            pass
   148→
   149→        try:
   150→            ctx.gpu_temp_c = nvml.nvmlDeviceGetTemperature(
   151→                self._handle, nvml.NVML_TEMPERATURE_GPU
   152→            )
   153→        except Exception:
   154→            pass
   155→
   156→        try:
   157→            util = nvml.nvmlDeviceGetUtilizationRates(self._handle)
   158→            ctx.gpu_util_pct = util.gpu
   159→        except Exception:
   160→            pass
   161→
   162→        try:
   163→            ctx.power_draw_w = nvml.nvmlDeviceGetPowerUsage(self._handle) / 1000.0
   164→        except Exception:
   165→            pass
   166→
   167→    def _fill_processes(self, ctx: SystemContext) -> None:
   168→        """Detect running processes and match to app profiles."""
   169→        # Get per-process VRAM from NVML
   170→        gpu_vram_by_pid: dict[int, float] = {}
   171→        if self.available:
   172→            nvml = self._nvml
   173→            try:
   174→                procs = nvml.nvmlDeviceGetComputeRunningProcesses(self._handle)
   175→                for p in procs:
   176→                    gpu_vram_by_pid[p.pid] = p.usedGpuMemory / (1024 * 1024)
   177→            except Exception:
   178→                pass
   179→            try:
   180→                gfx_procs = nvml.nvmlDeviceGetGraphicsRunningProcesses(self._handle)
   181→                for p in gfx_procs:
   182→                    mem = p.usedGpuMemory / (1024 * 1024) if p.usedGpuMemory else 0.0
   183→                    gpu_vram_by_pid[p.pid] = gpu_vram_by_pid.get(p.pid, 0.0) + mem
   184→            except Exception:
   185→                pass
   186→
   187→        seen_apps: set[str] = set()
   188→        for proc in psutil.process_iter(["pid", "name"]):
   189→            try:
   190→                pinfo = proc.info
   191→                pid = pinfo["pid"]
   192→                pname = (pinfo["name"] or "").lower()
   193→                app_name = self._match_app(proc, pname)
   194→                if app_name:
   195→                    seen_apps.add(app_name)
   196→                    ctx.processes.append(ProcessInfo(
   197→                        pid=pid,
   198→                        name=pname,
   199→                        app=app_name,
   200→                        vram_mb=gpu_vram_by_pid.get(pid, 0.0),
   201→                    ))
   202→            except (psutil.NoSuchProcess, psutil.AccessDenied):
   203→                continue
   204→
   205→        ctx.active_apps = sorted(seen_apps)
   206→
   207→    def _match_app(self, proc: Any, pname: str) -> str | None:
   208→        """Match a process to an app profile."""
   209→        for app_name, profile in self._app_profiles.items():
   210→            # Match by process name
   211→            if pname in [n.lower() for n in profile.process_names]:
   212→                return app_name
   213→            # Match by cmdline pattern (e.g. ComfyUI, Claude Code)
   214→            if profile.cmdline_pattern:
   215→                try:
   216→                    cmdline = " ".join(proc.cmdline())
   217→                    if profile.cmdline_pattern.search(cmdline):
   218→                        return app_name
   219→                except (psutil.NoSuchProcess, psutil.AccessDenied):
   220→                    continue
   221→        return None
   222→
   223→    def _detect_workflow(self, active_apps: list[str]) -> WorkflowMode:
   224→        """Determine workflow mode from active apps."""
   225→        if not active_apps:
   226→            return WorkflowMode.IDLE
   227→        if len(active_apps) > 1:
   228→            return WorkflowMode.MIXED
   229→        app = active_apps[0]
   230→        mode_map = {
   231→            "houdini": WorkflowMode.HOUDINI,
   232→            "unreal_engine": WorkflowMode.UNREAL_ENGINE,
   233→            "comfyui": WorkflowMode.COMFYUI,
   234→            "claude_code": WorkflowMode.CLAUDE_CODE,
   235→        }
   236→        return mode_map.get(app, WorkflowMode.IDLE)

1→"""Lightweight MoE coordinator.
     2→
     3→Takes TelemetryProvider + experts + action dispatch.
     4→Runs: snapshot -> dispatch to experts -> aggregate -> apply top N -> log.
     5→No genetic tuner, no LLM client, no MCP client.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from __future__ import annotations
     9→
    10→import logging
    11→from typing import Any
    12→
    13→from .actions.base import ActionHandler
    14→from .actions.env_var import EnvVarHandler
    15→from .actions.ini_file import IniFileHandler
    16→from .actions.process import ProcessHandler
    17→from .actions.registry import RegistryHandler
    18→from .models import (
    19→    CycleReport,
    20→    OptimizationAction,
    21→    OptimizationResult,
    22→    Recommendation,
    23→    SystemContext,
    24→)
    25→from .experts.base import Expert
    26→from .experts.gpu_specialist import GPUSpecialist
    27→from .experts.houdini_engineer import HoudiniEngineer
    28→from .experts.system_integrator import SystemIntegrator
    29→from .experts.ue5_engineer import UE5Engineer
    30→from .telemetry import TelemetryProvider
    31→
    32→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    33→
    34→
    35→def _default_experts() -> list[Expert]:
    36→    return [GPUSpecialist(), HoudiniEngineer(), UE5Engineer(), SystemIntegrator()]
    37→
    38→
    39→def _default_handlers() -> dict[OptimizationAction, ActionHandler]:
    40→    return {
    41→        OptimizationAction.ENV_VAR: EnvVarHandler(),
    42→        OptimizationAction.REGISTRY: RegistryHandler(),
    43→        OptimizationAction.PROCESS_PRIORITY: ProcessHandler(),
    44→        OptimizationAction.INI_FILE: IniFileHandler(),
    45→    }
    46→
    47→
    48→class Orchestrator:
    49→    """Coordinates experts and action handlers for optimization cycles."""
    50→
    51→    def __init__(
    52→        self,
    53→        telemetry: TelemetryProvider,
    54→        experts: list[Expert] | None = None,
    55→        handlers: dict[OptimizationAction, ActionHandler] | None = None,
    56→        max_recommendations: int = 10,
    57→        min_confidence: float = 0.6,
    58→    ):
    59→        self.telemetry = telemetry
    60→        self.experts = experts or _default_experts()
    61→        self.handlers = handlers or _default_handlers()
    62→        self.max_recommendations = max_recommendations
    63→        self.min_confidence = min_confidence
    64→
    65→    def run_cycle(self, dry_run: bool = False) -> CycleReport:
    66→        """Run a single optimization cycle."""
    67→        # 1. Snapshot
    68→        ctx = self.telemetry.snapshot()
    69→        logger.info(
    70→            "Snapshot: GPU=%s, VRAM=%.0f/%.0fMB, temp=%.0fC, mode=%s",
    71→            ctx.gpu_name, ctx.vram_used_mb, ctx.vram_total_mb,
    72→            ctx.gpu_temp_c, ctx.workflow_mode.value,
    73→        )
    74→
    75→        # 2. Dispatch to experts
    76→        all_recs: list[Recommendation] = []
    77→        for expert in self.experts:
    78→            try:
    79→                recs = expert.analyze(ctx)
    80→                all_recs.extend(recs)
    81→            except Exception as e:
    82→                logger.error("Expert %s failed: %s", expert.__class__.__name__, e)
    83→
    84→        # 3. Filter + sort by score (impact * confidence)
    85→        filtered = [r for r in all_recs if r.confidence >= self.min_confidence]
    86→        filtered.sort(key=lambda r: r.score, reverse=True)
    87→
    88→        # 4. Conflict resolution: deduplicate by (action, key params)
    89→        seen: set[str] = set()
    90→        deduped: list[Recommendation] = []
    91→        for rec in filtered:
    92→            key = self._dedup_key(rec)
    93→            if key not in seen:
    94→                seen.add(key)
    95→                deduped.append(rec)
    96→
    97→        # 5. Apply top N
    98→        to_apply = deduped[:self.max_recommendations]
    99→        skipped = deduped[self.max_recommendations:]
   100→        applied: list[OptimizationResult] = []
   101→        errors: list[str] = []
   102→
   103→        for rec in to_apply:
   104→            if rec.action == OptimizationAction.INFO:
   105→                # Info-only: log but don't apply
   106→                logger.info("[INFO] %s", rec.description)
   107→                applied.append(OptimizationResult(
   108→                    recommendation=rec, success=True, message=rec.description,
   109→                ))
   110→                continue
   111→
   112→            handler = self.handlers.get(rec.action)
   113→            if handler is None:
   114→                msg = f"No handler for action {rec.action.value}"
   115→                logger.warning(msg)
   116→                errors.append(msg)
   117→                continue
   118→
   119→            try:
   120→                success, msg, rollback = handler.apply(rec, dry_run=dry_run)
   121→                applied.append(OptimizationResult(
   122→                    recommendation=rec, success=success, message=msg,
   123→                    rollback_info=rollback,
   124→                ))
   125→                if success:
   126→                    logger.info("[%s] %s", "DRY" if dry_run else "APPLIED", msg)
   127→                else:
   128→                    logger.warning("[FAILED] %s: %s", rec.description, msg)
   129→            except Exception as e:
   130→                msg = f"Handler error for {rec.description}: {e}"
   131→                logger.error(msg)
   132→                errors.append(msg)
   133→
   134→        return CycleReport(
   135→            context=ctx,
   136→            recommendations=all_recs,
   137→            applied=applied,
   138→            skipped=skipped,
   139→            errors=errors,
   140→        )
   141→
   142→    def detect(self) -> SystemContext:
   143→        """Snapshot only — no optimization, just show current state."""
   144→        return self.telemetry.snapshot()
   145→
   146→    @staticmethod
   147→    def _dedup_key(rec: Recommendation) -> str:
   148→        """Generate a deduplication key for a recommendation."""
   149→        p = rec.parameters
   150→        if rec.action == OptimizationAction.ENV_VAR:
   151→            return f"env:{p.get('name', '')}"
   152→        if rec.action == OptimizationAction.REGISTRY:
   153→            return f"reg:{p.get('key_path', '')}\\{p.get('value_name', '')}"
   154→        if rec.action == OptimizationAction.PROCESS_PRIORITY:
   155→            return f"proc:{p.get('pid', '')}"
   156→        if rec.action == OptimizationAction.INI_FILE:
   157→            return f"ini:{p.get('section', '')}:{p.get('key', '')}"
   158→        return f"{rec.action.value}:{rec.description[:50]}"
   159→

1→"""GPU optimization expert — CUDA env vars, driver settings, VRAM pressure.
     2→
     3→Absorbs FP8/flash-attention rules from the deleted NVIDIAResearcher expert.
     4→"""
     5→
     6→from __future__ import annotations
     7→
     8→import os
     9→
    10→from ..models import (
    11→    ExpertType,
    12→    OptimizationAction,
    13→    Recommendation,
    14→    SystemContext,
    15→)
    16→from .base import Expert
    17→
    18→
    19→class GPUSpecialist(Expert):
    20→    """Analyzes GPU state and recommends CUDA / driver optimizations."""
    21→
    22→    def analyze(self, context: SystemContext) -> list[Recommendation]:
    23→        recs: list[Recommendation] = []
    24→
    25→        self._check_cuda_env(context, recs)
    26→        self._check_vram_pressure(context, recs)
    27→        self._check_fp8_flash_attention(context, recs)
    28→        self._check_power_thermal(context, recs)
    29→
    30→        return recs
    31→
    32→    def _check_cuda_env(self, ctx: SystemContext, recs: list[Recommendation]) -> None:
    33→        env = ctx.env_vars
    34→
    35→        # CUDA device order
    36→        if env.get("CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER") != "PCI_BUS_ID":
    37→            recs.append(Recommendation(
    38→                expert=ExpertType.GPU_SPECIALIST,
    39→                action=OptimizationAction.ENV_VAR,
    40→                description="Set CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID for deterministic GPU selection",
    41→                impact=0.3,
    42→                confidence=0.95,
    43→                parameters={"name": "CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER", "value": "PCI_BUS_ID"},
    44→            ))
    45→
    46→        # TF32 for Ada Lovelace
    47→        if env.get("NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE") != "1":
    48→            recs.append(Recommendation(
    49→                expert=ExpertType.GPU_SPECIALIST,
    50→                action=OptimizationAction.ENV_VAR,
    51→                description="Enable TF32 override for SM89 (Ada Lovelace) acceleration",
    52→                impact=0.6,
    53→                confidence=0.9,
    54→                parameters={"name": "NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE", "value": "1"},
    55→            ))
    56→
    57→        # CUDA cache
    58→        if not env.get("CUDA_CACHE_MAXSIZE"):
    59→            recs.append(Recommendation(
    60→                expert=ExpertType.GPU_SPECIALIST,
    61→                action=OptimizationAction.ENV_VAR,
    62→                description="Set CUDA cache max size to 1GB for kernel compilation caching",
    63→                impact=0.4,
    64→                confidence=0.85,
    65→                parameters={"name": "CUDA_CACHE_MAXSIZE", "value": "1073741824"},
    66→            ))
    67→
    68→    def _check_vram_pressure(self, ctx: SystemContext, recs: list[Recommendation]) -> None:
    69→        if ctx.vram_total_mb <= 0:
    70→            return
    71→        usage_pct = ctx.vram_used_mb / ctx.vram_total_mb
    72→        if usage_pct > 0.9:
    73→            recs.append(Recommendation(
    74→                expert=ExpertType.GPU_SPECIALIST,
    75→                action=OptimizationAction.INFO,
    76→                description=f"VRAM usage critical: {usage_pct:.0%} — consider closing unused GPU apps",
    77→                impact=0.9,
    78→                confidence=0.95,
    79→                parameters={"vram_usage_pct": usage_pct},
    80→            ))
    81→
    82→    def _check_fp8_flash_attention(self, ctx: SystemContext, recs: list[Recommendation]) -> None:
    83→        env = ctx.env_vars
    84→
    85→        # PyTorch expandable segments (prevents fragmentation)
    86→        alloc_conf = env.get("PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF", "")
    87→        if "expandable_segments" not in alloc_conf:
    88→            recs.append(Recommendation(
    89→                expert=ExpertType.GPU_SPECIALIST,
    90→                action=OptimizationAction.ENV_VAR,
    91→                description="Enable PyTorch expandable segments to reduce VRAM fragmentation",
    92→                impact=0.7,
    93→                confidence=0.9,
    94→                parameters={
    95→                    "name": "PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF",
    96→                    "value": "expandable_segments:True",
    97→                },
    98→            ))
    99→
   100→        # cuDNN benchmark mode
   101→        if env.get("CUDNN_BENCHMARK") != "1":
   102→            recs.append(Recommendation(
   103→                expert=ExpertType.GPU_SPECIALIST,
   104→                action=OptimizationAction.ENV_VAR,
   105→                description="Enable cuDNN benchmark for auto-tuning convolution algorithms",
   106→                impact=0.5,
   107→                confidence=0.85,
   108→                parameters={"name": "CUDNN_BENCHMARK", "value": "1"},
   109→            ))
   110→
   111→    def _check_power_thermal(self, ctx: SystemContext, recs: list[Recommendation]) -> None:
   112→        if ctx.gpu_temp_c > 85:
   113→            recs.append(Recommendation(
   114→                expert=ExpertType.GPU_SPECIALIST,
   115→                action=OptimizationAction.INFO,
   116→                description=f"GPU temp {ctx.gpu_temp_c:.0f}C exceeds 85C — check fan curve/airflow",
   117→                impact=0.8,
   118→                confidence=0.95,
   119→                parameters={"gpu_temp_c": ctx.gpu_temp_c},
   120→            ))

1→"""Houdini optimization expert — env vars, Karma XPU, VDB."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from ..models import (
     6→    ExpertType,
     7→    OptimizationAction,
     8→    Recommendation,
     9→    SystemContext,
    10→    WorkflowMode,
    11→)
    12→from .base import Expert
    13→
    14→# Houdini env vars that should be set for RTX 4090 workflows
    15→_HOUDINI_ENV = {
    16→    "HOUDINI_OCL_DEVICETYPE": ("GPU", 0.5, 0.9, "Route OpenCL to GPU"),
    17→    "HOUDINI_KARMA_XPU_ENABLE": ("1", 0.7, 0.9, "Enable Karma XPU for hybrid CPU/GPU rendering"),
    18→    "HOUDINI_NVIDIA_OPTIX_DEVICENUMBER": ("0", 0.4, 0.85, "Pin OptiX to RTX 4090 (device 0)"),
    19→    "HOUDINI_VDB_ACTIVATE_NANOVDB_CUDA": ("1", 0.6, 0.9, "Enable NanoVDB CUDA acceleration for volumes"),
    20→    "HOUDINI_THREAD_COUNT": ("48", 0.5, 0.85, "Set thread count to match Threadripper PRO 7965WX"),
    21→}
    22→
    23→
    24→class HoudiniEngineer(Expert):
    25→    """Analyzes Houdini-specific optimization opportunities."""
    26→
    27→    def analyze(self, context: SystemContext) -> list[Recommendation]:
    28→        recs: list[Recommendation] = []
    29→
    30→        # Only produce Houdini recs if Houdini is running or MIXED mode
    31→        if context.workflow_mode not in (WorkflowMode.HOUDINI, WorkflowMode.MIXED):
    32→            return recs
    33→
    34→        self._check_env_vars(context, recs)
    35→        self._check_opencl(context, recs)
    36→
    37→        return recs
    38→
    39→    def _check_env_vars(self, ctx: SystemContext, recs: list[Recommendation]) -> None:
    40→        env = ctx.env_vars
    41→        for var_name, (expected, impact, confidence, desc) in _HOUDINI_ENV.items():
    42→            if env.get(var_name) != expected:
    43→                recs.append(Recommendation(
    44→                    expert=ExpertType.HOUDINI_ENGINEER,
    45→                    action=OptimizationAction.ENV_VAR,
    46→                    description=f"Set {var_name}={expected} — {desc}",
    47→                    impact=impact,
    48→                    confidence=confidence,
    49→                    parameters={"name": var_name, "value": expected},
    50→                ))
    51→
    52→    def _check_opencl(self, ctx: SystemContext, recs: list[Recommendation]) -> None:

    61→                confidence=0.8,
    62→                parameters={"name": "HOUDINI_OCL_VENDOR", "value": "NVIDIA"},
    63→            ))

1→"""System-level optimization expert — PCIe, thermal, priority, affinity, VRAM coordination.
     2→
     3→Uses TelemetryProvider for GPU data (no own NVML init).
     4→"""
     5→
     6→from __future__ import annotations
     7→
     8→from ..models import (
     9→    ExpertType,
    10→    OptimizationAction,
    11→    Recommendation,
    12→    SystemContext,
    13→)
    14→from .base import Expert
    15→
    16→
    17→class SystemIntegrator(Expert):
    18→    """Cross-cutting system optimizations and hardware validation."""
    19→
    20→    def analyze(self, context: SystemContext) -> list[Recommendation]:
    21→        recs: list[Recommendation] = []
    22→
    23→        self._check_pcie(context, recs)
    24→        self._check_process_priority(context, recs)
    25→        self._check_vram_coordination(context, recs)
    26→        self._check_thermal(context, recs)
    27→
    28→        return recs
    29→
    30→    def _check_pcie(self, ctx: SystemContext, recs: list[Recommendation]) -> None:
    31→        if ctx.pcie_gen == 0:
    32→            return  # no data
    33→
    34→        if ctx.pcie_gen < 4:
    35→            recs.append(Recommendation(
    36→                expert=ExpertType.SYSTEM_INTEGRATOR,
    37→                action=OptimizationAction.INFO,
    38→                description=(
    39→                    f"PCIe Gen{ctx.pcie_gen} x{ctx.pcie_width} detected — "
    40→                    f"RTX 4090 supports Gen4. Check BIOS PCIe settings for potential "
    41→                    f"bandwidth bottleneck ({ctx.pcie_gen * 16:.0f} GB/s vs {4 * 16:.0f} GB/s for Gen4 x16)"
    42→                ),
    43→                impact=0.8,
    44→                confidence=0.95,
    45→                parameters={"pcie_gen": ctx.pcie_gen, "pcie_width": ctx.pcie_width},
    46→            ))
    47→
    48→        if ctx.pcie_width < 16:
    49→            recs.append(Recommendation(
    50→                expert=ExpertType.SYSTEM_INTEGRATOR,
    51→                action=OptimizationAction.INFO,
    52→                description=f"PCIe width x{ctx.pcie_width} — should be x16 for full bandwidth",
    53→                impact=0.7,
    54→                confidence=0.9,
    55→                parameters={"pcie_width": ctx.pcie_width},
    56→            ))
    57→
    58→    def _check_process_priority(self, ctx: SystemContext, recs: list[Recommendation]) -> None:
    59→        # Recommend high priority for active GPU apps
    60→        for proc in ctx.processes:
    61→            if proc.app in ("houdini", "unreal_engine", "comfyui"):
    62→                recs.append(Recommendation(
    63→                    expert=ExpertType.SYSTEM_INTEGRATOR,
    64→                    action=OptimizationAction.PROCESS_PRIORITY,
    65→                    description=f"Set {proc.app} (PID {proc.pid}) to High priority",
    66→                    impact=0.4,
    67→                    confidence=0.8,
    68→                    parameters={"pid": proc.pid, "priority": "high", "app": proc.app},
    69→                ))
    70→
    71→    def _check_vram_coordination(self, ctx: SystemContext, recs: list[Recommendation]) -> None:
    72→        if ctx.vram_total_mb <= 0:
    73→            return
    74→
    75→        # Sum per-app VRAM usage
    76→        app_vram: dict[str, float] = {}
    77→        for proc in ctx.processes:
    78→            if proc.app != "unknown":
    79→                app_vram[proc.app] = app_vram.get(proc.app, 0) + proc.vram_mb
    80→
    81→        total_used = sum(app_vram.values())
    82→        total_mb = ctx.vram_total_mb
    83→        if total_used > total_mb * 0.85:
    84→            breakdown = ", ".join(
    85→                f"{app}: {mb:.0f}MB" for app, mb in sorted(app_vram.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])
    86→            )
    87→            recs.append(Recommendation(
    88→                expert=ExpertType.SYSTEM_INTEGRATOR,
    89→                action=OptimizationAction.INFO,
    90→                description=f"VRAM contention ({total_used:.0f}/{total_mb:.0f} MB): {breakdown}",
    91→                impact=0.8,
    92→                confidence=0.9,
    93→                parameters={"app_vram": app_vram},
    94→            ))
    95→
    96→    def _check_thermal(self, ctx: SystemContext, recs: list[Recommendation]) -> None:
    97→        if ctx.gpu_temp_c > 90:
    98→            recs.append(Recommendation(
    99→                expert=ExpertType.SYSTEM_INTEGRATOR,
   100→                action=OptimizationAction.INFO,
   101→                description=f"GPU thermal throttling likely at {ctx.gpu_temp_c:.0f}C — immediate action needed",
   102→                impact=1.0,
   103→                confidence=0.95,
   104→                parameters={"gpu_temp_c": ctx.gpu_temp_c},
   105→            ))
   106→

1→"""Environment variable action handler — os.environ + setx for persistence."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import logging
     6→import os
     7→import subprocess
     8→from typing import Any
     9→
    10→from ..models import Recommendation
    11→from .base import ActionHandler
    12→
    13→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    14→
    15→
    16→class EnvVarHandler(ActionHandler):
    17→    """Set environment variables in current process and persist via setx."""
    18→
    19→    def apply(self, rec: Recommendation, dry_run: bool = False) -> tuple[bool, str, dict[str, Any]]:
    20→        name = rec.parameters.get("name", "")
    21→        value = rec.parameters.get("value", "")
    22→        if not name:
    23→            return False, "Missing env var name", {}
    24→
    25→        old_value = os.environ.get(name)
    26→        rollback = {"name": name, "old_value": old_value}
    27→
    28→        if dry_run:
    29→            return True, f"[DRY RUN] Would set {name}={value}", rollback
    30→
    31→        # Set in current process
    32→        os.environ[name] = value
    33→
    34→        # Persist via setx (Windows)
    35→        try:
    36→            subprocess.run(
    37→                ["setx", name, value],
    38→                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10,
    39→            )
    40→        except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, FileNotFoundError) as e:
    41→            logger.warning("setx failed for %s: %s (set in process only)", name, e)
    42→
    43→        msg = f"Set {name}={value}"
    44→        if old_value is not None:
    45→            msg += f" (was: {old_value})"
    46→        return True, msg, rollback
    47→
    48→    def rollback(self, rollback_info: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    49→        name = rollback_info.get("name", "")
    50→        old_value = rollback_info.get("old_value")
    51→        if not name:
    52→            return False
    53→        if old_value is None:
    54→            os.environ.pop(name, None)
    55→        else:
    56→            os.environ[name] = old_value
    57→        return True
    58→

1→"""Windows registry action handler.
     2→
     3→Critical bugfix from V7: _apply_registry_tweak expected key_path/value_name/value_data
     4→but GPUSpecialist sent setting/value — params never matched. Now uses normalized names:
     5→  key_path, value_name, value_data, value_type
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from __future__ import annotations
     9→
    10→import logging
    11→import platform
    12→from typing import Any
    13→
    14→from ..models import Recommendation
    15→from .base import ActionHandler
    16→
    17→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    18→
    19→# Common NVIDIA registry paths
    20→NVIDIA_DRIVER_KEY = r"SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4d36e968-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}\0000"
    21→
    22→# Lazy import winreg (only available on Windows)
    23→_winreg = None
    24→
    25→
    26→def _get_winreg():
    27→    global _winreg
    28→    if _winreg is None:
    29→        if platform.system() != "Windows":
    30→            raise RuntimeError("Registry operations only available on Windows")
    31→        import winreg
    32→        _winreg = winreg
    33→    return _winreg
    34→
    35→
    36→class RegistryHandler(ActionHandler):
    37→    """Apply and rollback Windows registry tweaks."""
    38→
    39→    def apply(self, rec: Recommendation, dry_run: bool = False) -> tuple[bool, str, dict[str, Any]]:
    40→        params = rec.parameters
    41→        key_path = params.get("key_path", "")
    42→        value_name = params.get("value_name", "")
    43→        value_data = params.get("value_data")
    44→        value_type = params.get("value_type", "REG_DWORD")
    45→
    46→        if not key_path or not value_name:
    47→            return False, "Missing key_path or value_name", {}
    48→
    49→        if dry_run:
    50→            return True, f"[DRY RUN] Would set {key_path}\\{value_name} = {value_data}", {}
    51→
    52→        try:
    53→            winreg = _get_winreg()
    54→            reg_type = getattr(winreg, value_type, winreg.REG_DWORD)
    55→
    56→            # Read old value for rollback
    57→            old_value = None
    58→            try:
    59→                with winreg.OpenKey(winreg.HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, key_path, 0, winreg.KEY_READ) as key:
    60→                    old_value, _ = winreg.QueryValueEx(key, value_name)
    61→            except (OSError, FileNotFoundError):
    62→                pass
    63→
    64→            # Write new value
    65→            with winreg.OpenKey(
    66→                winreg.HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, key_path, 0,
    67→                winreg.KEY_SET_VALUE,
    68→            ) as key:
    69→                winreg.SetValueEx(key, value_name, 0, reg_type, value_data)
    70→
    71→            rollback = {
    72→                "key_path": key_path,
    73→                "value_name": value_name,
    74→                "old_value": old_value,
    75→                "value_type": value_type,
    76→            }
    77→            return True, f"Set {key_path}\\{value_name} = {value_data}", rollback
    78→
    79→        except PermissionError:
    80→            return False, f"Permission denied — run as Administrator for registry access", {}
    81→        except Exception as e:
    82→            return False, f"Registry error: {e}", {}
    83→
    84→    def rollback(self, rollback_info: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    85→        key_path = rollback_info.get("key_path", "")
    86→        value_name = rollback_info.get("value_name", "")
    87→        old_value = rollback_info.get("old_value")
    88→        value_type = rollback_info.get("value_type", "REG_DWORD")
    89→
    90→        if not key_path or not value_name:
    91→            return False
    92→
    93→        try:
    94→            winreg = _get_winreg()
    95→            reg_type = getattr(winreg, value_type, winreg.REG_DWORD)
    96→
    97→            if old_value is None:
    98→                # Delete the value
    99→                with winreg.OpenKey(
   100→                    winreg.HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, key_path, 0,
   101→                    winreg.KEY_SET_VALUE,
   102→                ) as key:
   103→                    winreg.DeleteValue(key, value_name)
   104→            else:
   105→                with winreg.OpenKey(
   106→                    winreg.HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, key_path, 0,
   107→                    winreg.KEY_SET_VALUE,
   108→                ) as key:
   109→                    winreg.SetValueEx(key, value_name, 0, reg_type, old_value)
   110→            return True
   111→        except Exception as e:
   112→            logger.error("Registry rollback failed: %s", e)
   113→            return False
   114→

1→"""Process priority and CPU affinity action handler."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import logging
     6→from typing import Any
     7→
     8→import psutil
     9→
    10→from ..models import Recommendation
    11→from .base import ActionHandler
    12→
    13→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    14→
    15→_PRIORITY_MAP = {
    16→    "realtime": psutil.REALTIME_PRIORITY_CLASS,
    17→    "high": psutil.HIGH_PRIORITY_CLASS,
    18→    "above_normal": psutil.ABOVE_NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS,
    19→    "normal": psutil.NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS,
    20→    "below_normal": psutil.BELOW_NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS,
    21→    "idle": psutil.IDLE_PRIORITY_CLASS,
    22→}
    23→
    24→
    25→class ProcessHandler(ActionHandler):
    26→    """Set process priority and CPU affinity."""
    27→
    28→    def apply(self, rec: Recommendation, dry_run: bool = False) -> tuple[bool, str, dict[str, Any]]:
    29→        pid = rec.parameters.get("pid")
    30→        priority = rec.parameters.get("priority", "high")
    31→        affinity = rec.parameters.get("affinity")  # optional list of CPU cores
    32→
    33→        if pid is None:
    34→            return False, "Missing pid", {}
    35→
    36→        try:
    37→            proc = psutil.Process(pid)
    38→            old_priority = proc.nice()
    39→            old_affinity = proc.cpu_affinity()
    40→        except (psutil.NoSuchProcess, psutil.AccessDenied) as e:
    41→            return False, f"Cannot access PID {pid}: {e}", {}
    42→
    43→        rollback = {"pid": pid, "old_priority": old_priority, "old_affinity": old_affinity}
    44→
    45→        if dry_run:
    46→            msg = f"[DRY RUN] Would set PID {pid} priority={priority}"
    47→            if affinity:
    48→                msg += f", affinity={affinity}"
    49→            return True, msg, rollback
    50→
    51→        try:
    52→            new_priority = _PRIORITY_MAP.get(priority, psutil.HIGH_PRIORITY_CLASS)
    53→            proc.nice(new_priority)
    54→            msg = f"Set PID {pid} priority={priority}"
    55→
    56→            if affinity:
    57→                proc.cpu_affinity(affinity)
    58→                msg += f", affinity={affinity}"
    59→
    60→            return True, msg, rollback
    61→        except (psutil.AccessDenied, psutil.NoSuchProcess) as e:
    62→            return False, f"Failed to set priority for PID {pid}: {e}", rollback
    63→
    64→    def rollback(self, rollback_info: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    65→        pid = rollback_info.get("pid")
    66→        old_priority = rollback_info.get("old_priority")
    67→        old_affinity = rollback_info.get("old_affinity")
    68→
    69→        if pid is None:
    70→            return False
    71→        try:
    72→            proc = psutil.Process(pid)
    73→            if old_priority is not None:
    74→                proc.nice(old_priority)
    75→            if old_affinity is not None:
    76→                proc.cpu_affinity(old_affinity)
    77→            return True
    78→        except Exception as e:
    79→            logger.error("Process rollback failed for PID %s: %s", pid, e)
    80→            return False
    81→

1→"""INI file action handler — for UE5 Engine.ini and similar config files."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import configparser
     6→import logging
     7→import shutil
     8→from pathlib import Path
     9→from typing import Any
    10→
    11→from ..models import Recommendation
    12→from .base import ActionHandler
    13→
    14→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    15→
    16→# Default UE5 Engine.ini location
    17→_DEFAULT_ENGINE_INI = (
    18→    Path.home() / "AppData/Local/UnrealEngine/5.7/Saved/Config/Windows/Engine.ini"
    19→)
    20→
    21→
    22→class IniFileHandler(ActionHandler):
    23→    """Read/modify/write INI-style config files (primarily UE5 Engine.ini)."""
    24→
    25→    def __init__(self, ini_path: Path | None = None):
    26→        self._ini_path = ini_path or _DEFAULT_ENGINE_INI
    27→
    28→    def apply(self, rec: Recommendation, dry_run: bool = False) -> tuple[bool, str, dict[str, Any]]:
    29→        section = rec.parameters.get("section", "ConsoleVariables")
    30→        key = rec.parameters.get("key", "")
    31→        value = rec.parameters.get("value", "")
    32→        ini_path = Path(rec.parameters.get("ini_path", str(self._ini_path)))
    33→
    34→        if not key:
    35→            return False, "Missing INI key", {}
    36→
    37→        # Read existing value
    38→        old_value = None
    39→        config = configparser.ConfigParser(strict=False)
    40→        config.optionxform = str  # preserve case
    41→
    42→        if ini_path.exists():
    43→            config.read(str(ini_path), encoding="utf-8")
    44→            if config.has_option(section, key):
    45→                old_value = config.get(section, key)
    46→
    47→        rollback = {
    48→            "ini_path": str(ini_path),
    49→            "section": section,
    50→            "key": key,
    51→            "old_value": old_value,
    52→        }
    53→
    54→        if dry_run:
    55→            return True, f"[DRY RUN] Would set [{section}] {key}={value} in {ini_path}", rollback
    56→
    57→        # Backup before writing
    58→        if ini_path.exists():
    59→            backup = ini_path.with_suffix(".ini.bak")
    60→            shutil.copy2(ini_path, backup)
    61→
    62→        # Set the value
    63→        if not config.has_section(section):
    64→            config.add_section(section)
    65→        config.set(section, key, value)
    66→
    67→        # Write
    68→        ini_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    69→        with open(ini_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    70→            config.write(f)
    71→
    72→        msg = f"Set [{section}] {key}={value} in {ini_path.name}"
    73→        if old_value is not None:
    74→            msg += f" (was: {old_value})"
    75→        return True, msg, rollback
    76→
    77→    def rollback(self, rollback_info: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    78→        ini_path = Path(rollback_info.get("ini_path", ""))
    79→        section = rollback_info.get("section", "")
    80→        key = rollback_info.get("key", "")
    81→        old_value = rollback_info.get("old_value")
    82→
    83→        if not ini_path or not key:
    84→            return False
    85→
    86→        try:
    87→            config = configparser.ConfigParser(strict=False)
    88→            config.optionxform = str
    89→            if ini_path.exists():
    90→                config.read(str(ini_path), encoding="utf-8")
    91→
    92→            if old_value is None:
    93→                config.remove_option(section, key)
    94→            else:
    95→                if not config.has_section(section):
    96→                    config.add_section(section)
    97→                config.set(section, key, old_value)
    98→
    99→            with open(ini_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
   100→                config.write(f)
   101→            return True
   102→        except Exception as e:
   103→            logger.error("INI rollback failed: %s", e)
   104→            return False

1→"""CLI entry point for the GPU optimizer.
     2→
     3→Usage:
     4→    python run.py                    # Single optimization cycle
     5→    python run.py --monitor 60       # Continuous monitoring
     6→    python run.py --detect           # Show current optimization state
     7→    python run.py --apply-all        # Apply all high-impact optimizations
     8→    python run.py --dry-run          # Preview changes
     9→    python run.py --benchmark        # Run PyTorch benchmark
    10→"""
    11→
    12→from __future__ import annotations
    13→
    14→import argparse
    15→import logging
    16→import sys
    17→import time
    18→from pathlib import Path
    19→
    20→from .config import get_app_profiles, get_optimization_settings, load_config
    21→from .models import CycleReport, SystemContext, WorkflowMode
    22→from .orchestrator import Orchestrator
    23→from .telemetry import TelemetryProvider
    24→
    25→
    26→def _setup_logging(verbose: bool = False) -> None:
    27→    level = logging.DEBUG if verbose else logging.INFO
    28→    logging.basicConfig(
    29→        level=level,
    30→        format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s: %(message)s",
    31→        datefmt="%H:%M:%S",
    32→    )
    33→
    34→
    35→def _print_context(ctx: SystemContext) -> None:
    36→    """Print system context in a readable format."""
    37→    print("\n=== System State ===")
    38→    print(f"  GPU:         {ctx.gpu_name}")
    39→    print(f"  Driver:      {ctx.driver_version}")
    40→    print(f"  VRAM:        {ctx.vram_used_mb:.0f} / {ctx.vram_total_mb:.0f} MB ({ctx.vram_used_mb / max(ctx.vram_total_mb, 1) * 100:.0f}%)")
    41→    print(f"  Temperature: {ctx.gpu_temp_c:.0f}C")
    42→    print(f"  GPU Util:    {ctx.gpu_util_pct:.0f}%")
    43→    print(f"  Power:       {ctx.power_draw_w:.0f}W")
    44→    print(f"  PCIe:        Gen{ctx.pcie_gen} x{ctx.pcie_width}")
    45→    print(f"  Workflow:    {ctx.workflow_mode.value}")
    46→    if ctx.active_apps:
    47→        print(f"  Active apps: {', '.join(ctx.active_apps)}")
    48→    if ctx.processes:
    49→        print(f"  GPU processes:")
    50→        for p in ctx.processes:
    51→            print(f"    - {p.app} (PID {p.pid}): {p.vram_mb:.0f} MB VRAM")
    52→    print()
    53→
    54→
    55→def _print_report(report: CycleReport) -> None:
    56→    """Print optimization cycle report."""
    57→    _print_context(report.context)
    58→
    59→    if report.applied:
    60→        print("=== Applied Optimizations ===")
    61→        for result in report.applied:
    62→            status = "OK" if result.success else "FAIL"
    63→            score = result.recommendation.score
    64→            print(f"  [{status}] (score={score:.2f}) {result.message}")
    65→        print()
    66→
    67→    if report.skipped:
    68→        print(f"=== Skipped ({len(report.skipped)} below cutoff) ===")
    69→        for rec in report.skipped[:5]:
    70→            print(f"  (score={rec.score:.2f}) {rec.description}")
    71→        print()
    72→
    73→    if report.errors:
    74→        print("=== Errors ===")
    75→        for err in report.errors:
    76→            print(f"  ! {err}")
    77→        print()
    78→
    79→    total = len(report.applied)
    80→    ok = sum(1 for r in report.applied if r.success)
    81→    print(f"Summary: {ok}/{total} optimizations applied, {len(report.errors)} errors")
    82→
    83→
    84→def _run_benchmark() -> None:
    85→    """Run PyTorch benchmark if available."""
    86→    bench_path = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "benchmarks" / "pytorch_bench.py"
    87→    if not bench_path.exists():
    88→        print(f"Benchmark not found: {bench_path}")
    89→        return
    90→    import subprocess
    91→    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(bench_path)])
    92→
    93→
    94→def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    95→    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="GPU Optimizer V8 — RTX 4090 Workstation")
    96→    parser.add_argument("--detect", action="store_true", help="Show current system state")
    97→    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Preview changes without applying")
    98→    parser.add_argument("--apply-all", action="store_true", help="Apply all high-impact optimizations")
    99→    parser.add_argument("--monitor", type=int, metavar="SEC", help="Continuous monitoring interval")
   100→    parser.add_argument("--benchmark", action="store_true", help="Run PyTorch benchmark")
   101→    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, help="Config file path")
   102→    parser.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true", help="Verbose logging")
   103→    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
   104→
   105→    _setup_logging(args.verbose)
   106→
   107→    if args.benchmark:
   108→        _run_benchmark()
   109→        return 0
   110→
   111→    # Load config
   112→    cfg = load_config(args.config)
   113→    profiles = get_app_profiles(cfg)
   114→    settings = get_optimization_settings(cfg)
   115→
   116→    # Init telemetry and orchestrator
   117→    telemetry = TelemetryProvider(app_profiles=profiles)
   118→    orchestrator = Orchestrator(
   119→        telemetry=telemetry,
   120→        max_recommendations=settings["max_recommendations_per_cycle"],
   121→        min_confidence=settings["min_confidence"],
   122→    )
   123→
   124→    if args.detect:
   125→        ctx = orchestrator.detect()
   126→        _print_context(ctx)
   127→        return 0
   128→
   129→    if args.monitor:
   130→        print(f"Monitoring every {args.monitor}s (Ctrl+C to stop)")
   131→        try:
   132→            while True:
   133→                report = orchestrator.run_cycle(dry_run=args.dry_run)
   134→                _print_report(report)
   135→                time.sleep(args.monitor)
   136→        except KeyboardInterrupt:
   137→            print("\nMonitoring stopped.")
   138→        return 0
   139→
   140→    # Single cycle
   141→    report = orchestrator.run_cycle(dry_run=args.dry_run)
   142→    _print_report(report)
   143→    return 0 if not report.errors else 1
   144→

1→"""PyTorch GPU benchmark for RTX 4090.
     2→
     3→Moved from post_benchmark.py — measures real GPU throughput.
     4→"""
     5→
     6→from __future__ import annotations
     7→
     8→import sys
     9→import time
    10→
    11→
    12→def run_benchmark() -> None:
    13→    try:
    14→        import torch
    15→    except ImportError:
    16→        print("PyTorch not installed — skipping benchmark")
    17→        return
    18→
    19→    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
    20→        print("CUDA not available — skipping benchmark")
    21→        return
    22→
    23→    device = torch.device("cuda:0")
    24→    print(f"Device: {torch.cuda.get_device_name(device)}")
    25→    print(f"CUDA: {torch.version.cuda}")
    26→    print(f"PyTorch: {torch.__version__}")
    27→    print()
    28→
    29→    # Warmup
    30→    x = torch.randn(1024, 1024, device=device)
    31→    _ = x @ x
    32→
    33→    # Matrix multiply benchmark
    34→    sizes = [1024, 2048, 4096, 8192]
    35→    for n in sizes:
    36→        a = torch.randn(n, n, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
    37→        b = torch.randn(n, n, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
    38→        torch.cuda.synchronize()
    39→
    40→        start = time.perf_counter()
    41→        iters = 10
    42→        for _ in range(iters):
    43→            _ = a @ b
    44→        torch.cuda.synchronize()
    45→        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
    46→
    47→        flops = 2 * n * n * n * iters / elapsed
    48→        print(f"  {n}x{n} matmul: {elapsed / iters * 1000:.2f} ms/iter, {flops / 1e12:.2f} TFLOPS")
    49→
    50→    # FP16 benchmark
    51→    print("\nFP16 (Tensor Cores):")
    52→    for n in [4096, 8192]:
    53→        a = torch.randn(n, n, device=device, dtype=torch.float16)
    54→        b = torch.randn(n, n, device=device, dtype=torch.float16)
    55→        torch.cuda.synchronize()
    56→
    57→        start = time.perf_counter()
    58→        iters = 10
    59→        for _ in range(iters):
    60→            _ = a @ b
    61→        torch.cuda.synchronize()
    62→        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
    63→
    64→        flops = 2 * n * n * n * iters / elapsed
    65→        print(f"  {n}x{n} matmul: {elapsed / iters * 1000:.2f} ms/iter, {flops / 1e12:.2f} TFLOPS")
    66→
    67→    # Memory bandwidth test
    68→    print("\nMemory bandwidth:")
    69→    size_gb = 4
    70→    n_elements = size_gb * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 // 4  # float32
    71→    data = torch.randn(n_elements, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
    72→    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    73→
    74→    start = time.perf_counter()
    75→    iters = 5
    76→    for _ in range(iters):
    77→        _ = data.clone()
    78→    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    79→    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
    80→
    81→    bw = 2 * size_gb * iters / elapsed  # read + write
    82→    print(f"  {size_gb}GB copy: {bw:.1f} GB/s effective bandwidth")
    83→
    84→    vram_free = torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)[0] / (1024**3)
    85→    print(f"\nVRAM free: {vram_free:.1f} GB")
